hero_title: A secure space for conversations that stay private.
hero_subtitle: LAJU brings peace of mind back to daily messaging. Your texts, voice and video calls, and daily updates are protected with automatic end-to-end encryption—free of ads, surveillance, and corporate tracking.
features_subtitle: From daily talks, clear calls, to sharing moments—everything is built so you remain in total control.
features_item1_desc: Send texts, photos, voice notes, and stickers with default encryption.
features_item2_desc: Direct device-to-device calls with zero recording servers, low latency, and low data use.
features_item3_desc: Messages automatically delete based on your timer, leaving zero traces behind.
features_item4_desc: Share photos or short videos strictly with contacts you choose.
features_item5_desc: Lock chats with Fingerprint or PIN, reinforced with screen-capture prevention.
features_item6_desc: Lightweight, battery-efficient, zero ads, and you can delete your account anytime.
sec_desc: Every message, voice call, and file is encrypted directly on the sender's device using the Double Ratchet protocol and Ed25519/X25519 keys. Our servers only route signals and cannot read what you send.
sec_card1_sub: Private keys never leave your phone
sec_card2_sub: No profiling or personal activity tracking
disappear_desc: Not every talk needs a permanent record. Set disappearing timers so message history cleans itself up automatically, leaving no traces behind.
cta_subtitle_line1: Available immediately for Android via official APK release.
cta_subtitle_line2: Free to download, easy to install, and ready in seconds.

about_meta_title: About LAJU | Open Source, Privacy-First Messenger
about_meta_desc: Why we built LAJU: a fast, quiet messaging platform with no ads, placing user privacy first.
about_hero_title: A Messenger Built with Privacy as Priority One
about_hero_lead: We created LAJU to provide a clean, secure, and respectful messaging space—a place where your conversations remain private between you and those you trust.
about_photo_caption: LAJU is built so you can connect in peace and comfort.
about_section1_p1: Many modern chat apps continuously monitor user behavior, gather personal data for targeted advertising, and load interfaces with noisy distractions.
about_section1_p2: We believe personal conversations should remain strictly protected. What you share with family, friends, and coworkers is not commercial commodity.
about_section2_title: Back to What Messaging Should Be
about_section2_p1: LAJU is engineered to be lightweight, responsive, and effortless. Messages deliver instantly, calls sound crisp, and every exchange is shielded with high-grade cryptography.
about_section2_p2: You can enjoy meaningful conversations without worrying about third parties snooping on your data.
about_principles_sub: The guiding rules behind every design decision and feature in LAJU.
about_principle1_desc: End-to-end encryption is on by default for all chats. We never store readable messages or private keys on servers.
about_principle2_desc: Ad-free, tracker-free, with no addictive tricks. Designed to run smoothly and conserve battery.
about_principle3_desc: The complete source code is openly hosted on GitHub under GNU AGPLv3 for public transparency.
about_open_source_closing: We believe fundamental communication tools belong to the public. LAJU's source code is openly available on GitHub for anyone who values privacy sovereignty.

help_articles_sub: Official user guide for LAJU Messenger
help_faq1_title: 1. How do I get started with LAJU?
help_faq1_desc: Simply install the LAJU APK, choose a unique Username, set a 6-digit backup PIN, and your account is active immediately. All encryption keys are created directly on your device.
help_faq1_tip: Keep your Username and 6-digit PIN safe. This PIN helps secure your app and restore access on new devices.
help_faq2_title: 2. What happens if I forget my backup PIN?
help_faq2_desc: If you can still open the app via Fingerprint or Face Unlock, you can update your PIN in Settings > Security. However, if the app is removed and the PIN is lost, previous message history cannot be restored to protect cryptographic integrity.
help_faq3_title: 3. Why do messages occasionally delay until I open the app?
help_faq3_desc: Some Android brands apply aggressive power-saving policies. To ensure real-time alerts, go to Android Settings > Apps > LAJU > Battery and choose 'Unrestricted' or allow background activity.
help_faq4_title: 4. What is the call quality like on LAJU?
help_faq4_desc: Calls use WebRTC Peer-to-Peer (P2P) technology. Audio and video connect directly between devices without going through recording servers, resulting in clearer audio, minimal latency, and low data use.
help_faq5_title: 5. How do I contact the LAJU support team?
help_faq5_desc: You can report issues from inside the app via Settings > Help, or email support@laju.chat directly.
help_contact_box_desc: Got questions about security, feature requests, or technical issues? Our team is here to help:
privacy_meta_desc: LAJU official privacy policy: comprehensive data protection, default end-to-end encryption, and zero ads.
privacy_hero_desc: Your messages and calls on LAJU can only be seen and heard by you and the person you're talking to. Everything is locked securely on your phone, keeping your conversations private from everyone else.
privacy_pillars_sub: Our foundational principles in preserving confidentiality across every conversation.
privacy_pillar1_desc: Text, photos, voice notes, and documents are encrypted on the sender's phone and only decrypted on the recipient's phone.
privacy_pillar2_desc: We do not mandate sensitive personal details. Your account is anchored to cryptographic keys created on your phone.
privacy_pillar3_desc: Free of third-party advertising SDKs like Google AdMob or Meta SDK. We do not build commercial profiles.
privacy_pillar4_desc: Disappearing timers let chats vanish automatically, and accounts can be permanently wiped whenever you decide.
privacy_articles_sub: Applies to all users across the LAJU Messenger platform
privacy_sec1_lead: LAJU minimizes data collection right from the first step:
privacy_sec1_p1_desc: No personal telephone numbers are published or harvested for commercial promotions.
privacy_sec1_p2_desc: You can start communicating safely and independently right away.
privacy_sec1_p3_desc: We do not request identity cards, birth dates, or legal profile info.
privacy_sec1_p4_desc: Accounts operate exclusively using cryptographic keypairs (Ed25519 & X25519) generated on your phone.
privacy_sec2_item1_desc: Text, media, photos, audio, and documents never exist in readable form on our servers.
privacy_sec2_item2_desc: We never copy or upload your device contacts to our servers. Adding contacts is done manually.
privacy_sec2_item3_desc: We never track your location silently. Location is only accessed when you explicitly share live location in chat.
privacy_sec2_item4_desc: Voice and video calls stream directly peer-to-peer via WebRTC without recording on servers.
privacy_sec3_desc: All messages travel as encrypted envelopes. Servers only forward them to recipients or hold them briefly for offline delivery. You retain full control via recall, disappearing message timers, and chat clearing.
privacy_sec4_desc: Whenever you choose to leave LAJU, open Settings > Account > Delete Account to permanently wipe your username, sessions, and data from server databases.
privacy_sec5_desc: If you have questions or suggestions regarding privacy on LAJU, reach out to our team at:
terms_meta_desc: Fair and transparent terms of service for LAJU Messenger, focused on user protection.
terms_hero_desc: LAJU delivers secure, encrypted messaging and calls that respect your rights. These terms are written plainly so your privacy is protected and the network remains safe for everyone.
terms_card_desc: We do not sell user data, do not inject distracting commercial ads, and make zero copyright claims over your messages.
terms_pillars_sub: Clear rules and guarantees binding developers and all users.
terms_pillar1_desc: Your account is bound to your device security keys, keeping control in your hands.
terms_pillar2_desc: All text, media, voice notes, and documents you send belong strictly and exclusively to you.
terms_pillar3_desc: Using LAJU for malware distribution, automated spam flooding, or illegal exploitation is prohibited.
terms_pillar4_desc: You are free to delete your account from servers at any time without fees, friction, or penalties.
terms_articles_sub: Applies to all users across the LAJU Messenger platform
terms_sec1_body: By downloading and using LAJU, you agree to these Terms of Service and our Privacy Policy. LAJU provides high-speed, end-to-end encrypted messaging infrastructure.
terms_sec2_body: LAJU is designed to safeguard your privacy. Accounts are created autonomously through on-device security keys without exploiting personal information.
terms_sec3_body: Because LAJU servers do not store your PIN, you are responsible for remembering your backup PIN. LAJU developers have no backdoors to restore chats if the device and PIN are lost.
terms_sec4_body: To ensure reliable network operations, users agree not to use LAJU for relay-flooding bots, malware distribution, or unlawful exploitation.
terms_sec5_body: You hold complete control over your conversation lifecycle, including delete-for-everyone recall, disappearing message timers, and complete history purging.
terms_sec6_body: LAJU relay services are engineered for high resilience. However, real-time connectivity is also subject to local transit carriers and internet service providers.
terms_sec7_body: You can terminate your account anytime in Settings > Delete Account. For questions or support, contact support@laju.chat.
download_desc: Start private, lightweight, and secure messaging directly from our official device releases.

download_guide_title: 4 Simple Steps to Install the APK on Android
download_step1_desc: Tap the 'Download APK for Android' button above and wait for the file to finish downloading in your browser.
download_step2_desc: Swipe down to open your Android notification tray or locate the file inside your phone's 'Downloads' folder.
download_step3_desc: If Android displays an unknown app security prompt, tap 'Settings' and toggle 'Allow from this source'.
download_step4_desc: Tap 'Install' and wait a few seconds. Launch LAJU and enjoy private, secure messaging right away!
